subject: Secure deployment architecture review - next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Kulkarni <rajesh.k@northridge-med.com>
Cc: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@northridge-med.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Secure deployment architecture review - next steps

Hi Rajesh / Lindsey,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good discussion on your compliance constraints and the broad requirements for a private deployment in your GCP environment. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment heading into the architecture review: 

- Recap: You need a VPC-isolated private deployment with customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention for 3+ years, and strict egress rules. You also emphasized a requirement for offline model packaging for air-gapped locations.
- Next step: Technical architecture review / deep dive with our infra & security engineers to go through network diagrams, firewall/NAT expectations, KMS integration, and runtime sizing for inference.

Would you be available for a 60–75 minute architecture review next week? Proposing three windows (all PT):
1) Tue, Jun 16 — 13:00–14:15 PT
2) Wed, Jun 17 — 09:00–10:15 PT
3) Thu, Jun 18 — 11:00–12:15 PT

Please let me know which slot works best or share alternatives. If you can, please attach your current network diagram and any KMS/crypto policy docs — that will help us tailor the agenda. I attached a short pre-deepdive checklist so we can triage questions ahead of the call.

Agenda (proposed):
- Introductions & goals (5 min)
- Customer network, VPC, and connectivity constraints (15–20 min)
- KMS/HSM and data-at-rest considerations (15 min)
- Runtime topology and scaling/fallback options (15–20 min)
- Action items & rollout plan (10 min)

CC'ing Karthik (solutions) and Chloe (eng ops) so we can include the right engineers.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: pre-deepdive-checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Rajesh Kulkarni <rajesh.k@northridge-med.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@northridge-med.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Secure deployment architecture review - next steps

Thanks Vanessa — the recap is accurate. We're keen to get into the technical details as soon as possible. A couple of quick notes before we lock a time: 

- We operate across two GCP projects (prod and staging). Prod has a very restrictive egress policy; we'll need to validate any external endpoints.
- Our security team (I'll loop them in if needed) will want to validate KMS integrations and HSM options.
- For scheduling, Tue Jun 16 at 13:00 PT is OK for myself but Lindsey will confirm — she is on call that afternoon.

I've attached our high-level network diagram (Northridge_network_v1.pdf). It shows the current peering and NAT setup. We haven't published our KMS policies to the repo yet but I can share a sanitized version if that helps.

One more ask: can your team cover expected egress patterns and what endpoints (if any) Redwood Control Plane will call during a private deployment? We need that up front for firewall rules.

Best,
Rajesh
Director, Infrastructure & Security
Northridge Medical Group
Attachment: Northridge_network_v1.pdf

Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 19:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Secure deployment architecture review - next steps

Rajesh / Vanessa / Lindsey — thanks for the diagram Rajesh, that's helpful. 

We can take Tue Jun 16 at 13:00 PT for a 75-minute session. I'll lead the deep dive from our side and will bring:
- Karthik (me) — solutions engineering (network, routing, failover)
- Chloe Martin — infra ops (deployment topology, autoscale, logging)
- Markus (runtime lead) — we'll invite him to cover runtime kernel selection and quantization tradeoffs (he'll join as optional).

We'll prepare a short slide deck that outlines expected egress endpoints (control-plane and telemetry), recommended firewall rules, and a checklist for KMS/HSM integration. Expect that deck in the shared Drive by EOD Mon.

Proposed calendar invite: Tue, Jun 16 13:00–14:15 PT — 75 min — "Northridge | Redwood — Private Deploy Architecture Review". I'll create the invite and include a Google Meet link. Vanessa — do you want me to include any extra internal notes in the invite?

Action items before the call:
- Rajesh: confirm Lindsey's availability + share sanitized KMS policy if possible
- Vanessa: share customer-facing goals & success criteria doc (one pager)
- Chloe/Karthik: draft egress/ports doc and upload to the Drive

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Hi all — thanks for the flexibility. I can join Tue Jun 16 at 13:00 PT. Please send the calendar invite and the Drive link to the prep materials. A couple of items we'll want covered briefly during the review:

- Expected telemetry and whether logs/metrics are pushed to your control plane by default
- Options for an entirely air-gapped runtime (what is realistically possible out-of-the-box vs. custom work)

I'll also share the sanitized KMS policy by EOD Mon.
